description: This Java class provides utility methods to verify and check the status of fixed deposit accounts in integration tests for Apache Fineract. It includes methods to verify various states such as approved, pending, active, rejected, withdrawn, closed, as well as specific states like prematurely closed and matured. It also contains methods to retrieve the current status of a fixed deposit account via REST API calls.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountStatusChecker
classes.description: A utility class for verifying the status of fixed deposit accounts in integration tests. Contains methods to assert various states of fixed deposit accounts and to retrieve their status via API calls.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositIsApproved
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account status is approved by checking the status map.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositIsPending
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account status is pending approval.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositIsActive
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account status is active.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositIsRejected
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account status is rejected.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositIsWithdrawn
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account status is withdrawn by the applicant.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositAccountIsClosed
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account status is closed.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositAccountIsNotActive
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account is not active.

methods.name: getStatusOfFixedDepositAccount
methods.description: Gets the current status of a fixed deposit account by making an API call and returns the status map.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositAccountIsPrematureClosed
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account has been prematurely closed.

methods.name: verifyFixedDepositAccountIsMatured
methods.description: Verifies that a fixed deposit account has matured.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Internal helper method to extract a boolean status from the status map based on the status key.
